result.instructions: Tools for ServiceBridge, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which work orders are scheduled for tomorrow, and which team is on each one?"; "Find the customer named Smith and show their open estimates."; "List the invoices from last month that are still unpaid.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ServiceBridge data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run servicebridge_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run servicebridge_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run servicebridge_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. servicebridge_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: servicebridge_whoami

tools.description: Show the API user and the account profile the connection uses. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Users/Current.

tools.name: servicebridge_list_customers

tools.name: servicebridge_get_customer

tools.description: Get one customer by id. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Customers/{id}.

tools.name: servicebridge_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List customer contacts, optionally for one customer or location. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Contacts.

customerFilter.description: Only contacts of this customer id.

locationFilter.description: Only contacts of this location id.

customerFilter.description: Only locations of this customer id.

branchFilter.description: Only work orders of this branch id.

statusFilter.description: Only work orders with this status (vendor status name).

tools.description: Add an activity note to a customer, job, invoice or location. Writes to the account. ServiceBridge REST: POST /ActivityNote.
